notes: This is the first official noted push for Bubble Borough.
[bullet] Updated turn animation to give fish a more three-dimensional perspective.
[bullet] Updated the fish leveling and variant unlock system.
[bullet] Improved fish movement, behavior, and depth rendering.
[bullet] Expanded decor interactions and aquarium customization.
knownIssues: Fish sometimes get caught on decor or other fish, resulting in strange stuttering behavior.
When changing gravel color, the zoom-out frame may get stuck when exiting edit mode and only clear after refreshing the browser.
Fish can snap in a direction instead of gradually swimming that way.
Fish can disappear momentarily or clip through cave images and cave walls.

notes: [bullet] The illness, pharmacy, and veterinary systems are temporarily disabled while ongoing issues are addressed.
[bullet] Unlock progression has also been disabled for now.
[bullet] Fish can still die, but they may now recover naturally instead of requiring medicine or a diagnosis.
[bullet] A 3D browser version of Bubble Borough is currently in development.
